image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of two dark purple figs. The foreground fig is in sharp focus, showing a rounded, slightly flattened shape with deep purple skin that has subtle reddish undertones and a matte, slightly wrinkled texture. A distinct, small, circular ostiole (eye) is visible at the center of the bottom surface, appearing as a light beige opening surrounded by a darker ring. The background fig is out of focus, providing depth context. The lighting is soft, creating gentle shadows and highlighting the skin texture.
